resources.string: Watches for the Muse session results screen, expands the Mind graph, captures it losslessly and computes an Integrated Calm Score. Nothing leaves your device.
No sessions yet.\n\nEnable the accessibility service in Settings, then finish a Muse session. The results screen is captured and scored automatically.
Capture is off — the accessibility service is not enabled. Open Settings to turn it on.
Lower is calmer. Shaded band is the interquartile range within each session.
Also capture Brainwave Powerbands (unparsed, kept for future algorithms)
Reprocess all history with current algorithm
Export this session as a ZIP

Runs the same graph analyzer over screenshots you took before this app existed. The trace is recovered from pixels; the session date is read from the file\'s timestamp, and band times are unknown, so the score is normalised by the plotted width instead of Muse\'s classified time. Imported sessions are marked so you can tell them apart.
